cast.say: One sock left. The other one... gone.

panels.caption: It was night. It's always night.

cast.think: Everyone's a suspect. Even the cat.

cast.say: Where were you at shift change?

panels.caption: The cat walked. Cats always walk.

cast.say: Nice sock, kid. Where's its partner?
Sock? What sock? No sock here.
Four hundred socks. Not one pair.

panels.caption: A search of the suspect's den.

cast.say: Elves don't wear socks. So talk.
We wear nothing that was ever alive.
Then why is there a sock on your hand?
This is Leaf. Leaf is my friend.

cast.think: I need a drink. Leaf too.

panels.caption: Case closed. Case also on fire.
In this fort, the law wears socks.

cast.say: My own sock. Gone. Now it's personal.
It was on my other foot. Over the first.
Here we are, kids! Our new home!
The SKY? Disgusting. Take me down.
We all are. I was a poet.
Other? That's for all nine of you.
Rule one: stay out of the caverns.
Rule two: don't wave at the carp.
The dwarf who knew rule four is gone.
Remember when we were like that?
Water falls out of the sky?
Snow! Let's go out and play.

panels.caption: They stayed in. The snow plotted on.

cast.say: The sun is a fire nobody tends.
He's not falling apart. He's letting go.
So the carp can't get us!
For bravery, I name you Captain.

panels.caption: The captain issued his first order.

cast.think: The cats are a spy network.

cast.say: Danger room is for dwarves only.

cast.think: Every spear is a stick. Fetch.

cast.say: I brought a gift. A sapling!
Is this cup... made of wood?
In my forest we'd talk about feelings.
I've asked the rock for permission.
Rocks always say no. That's the fun.
My essay! Chapter one: they love the dark.
Chapter two: they fear the sky.
They're scared of ME. It's sweet.
Mother, I've decided to become a miner.
Back in my day, this fort was one tunnel.
Slept in it. Ate in it. Drank in it.
One barrel. We called it 'the tavern.'
I once wrestled a carp for a mug of wine.
When I was a lad, there was no sky.
Grandpa, there's always been a sky.
Not with a proper ceiling over it.
Migrants! Bah! In my day nobody came.
We never told anybody where we were.

cast.think: Just me and a rock. Paradise.

cast.say: We walked to the well uphill. Both ways.
The fort is all ramps, Grandpa.
Kadol! You haven't aged a day!
I died, Urist. Forty years ago.

gags.caption: The sock council needs a matching pair for quorum. It has never met.
The engraving shows the magma pipe's design, then its triumph, then the funeral.
"Forty barrels for a kitten?" "She's a ☼kitten☼. Note the little suns."
Three months in a mood, {citizen_first} made a door. It opens both ways. Emotionally.
The pump stack works perfectly, provided nobody asks where the water goes.
Hospital visiting hours begin when the patient stops throwing the splint.
The bookkeeper has finished counting the rocks. He'd like a word about the gravel.
Full moon tonight. Please return all borrowed dwarves by sunset.
The hill titan asked for directions. We pointed up, out, and very far away.
The necromancer's book club only discusses dead authors. In person.
The memorial slab reads: 'Here lies Urist. He wanted to see what the lever did.'
The duke demanded the biggest bedroom in the fort. Technically, that's the mine.
The dwarven caravan brought letters from the Mountainhomes. Every one says 'Send beer.'
Day four of the siege. A goblin has knocked to ask if we have a washroom.
A kobold returned something it stole. Experts warn this is how it steals trust.
Proud parents: their baby has been carried into more battles than the captain.
Motion to rename the dining hall the 'nap hall' passes, {cats} cats to zero.
{dogs} dogs, one bone, and a full diplomatic crisis.
{drinks} drinks left. The brewer now speaks only in whispers and avoids eye contact.
With {drinks} drinks in stock, the tavern has replaced all its chairs with barrels.
No meat in stores. The cook has started looking at the carp with real ambition.
The farmer calls the rain 'free water.' The fort reminds him nothing is free.
Snow buried the trade depot. The merchants are calling it 'a cozy delay.' Day nine.
{artifact} now has its own bedroom. It has nicer furniture than the mayor.
Today's weather: {weather}. Dwarves describe it as 'that stuff up there.'
{fort}: population {pop}, plus whatever lives in the second cavern.
The scholars finally proved the sky exists. Then they voted to wall it in.
The bard's new ballad rhymes 'carp' with 'carp.' Critics call it 'bold.'
Minecart mail arrives in seconds. The letters arrive as confetti.
Wishes made at the well this year: 412. Granted: 0. Buckets lost: 411.
The forgotten beast's attack has been postponed. It forgot.
The new militia uniforms are complete, except the left boots. Ask the kobolds.
Dining hall rule: no throwing mugs, except in emotional emergencies. It is always one.
The haulers' union demands one break per stone. There are four million stones.
The overseer designated a new stockpile. It is directly on top of the old one.
The motto is 'Losing is Fun.' The accounts say we're having the time of our lives.
Tantrum update: the mug thrown last spring has finally landed.
New vintage: plump helmet wine, aged three days. Notes of mushroom and apology.
The migrants brought nothing but seven dogs and strong opinions about the stairs.
The ghost won't pay rent, but has offered to haunt the tax collector for free.
Clear skies today. Officials urge everyone to stay calm and stand under something.
Summer heat: even the magma forge has asked for a day off.
Autumn: the elves' annual season of grieving every single leaf, individually.
The hospital stocks one medicine. It is also sold in the tavern, cheaper.
